channel.title: AI Threat Watch: MX
channel.description: Verified case files located in MX.

item.title: [HIGH] IPN expels student accused of AI-altering classmates' photos into sexual content; later jailed
item.description: Female students at Mexico's National Polytechnic Institute accused classmate Diego 'N' of editing their social media photos with AI into sexual content and selling it; about 160,000 images and 2,000 videos were found on his tablet. IPN expelled him and Mexico City prosecutors arrested him in October 2023; he was acquitted on two digital violence counts in December 2024, but sentenced in May 2025 to five years for storing child sexual abuse material. Target: Female students aged 17 to 25 at the IPN's ESCA Santo Tomás campus, Mexico City. MX. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Hacker uses Claude to breach Mexican agencies and steal 150GB of tax and voter data
item.description: Gambit Security found an attacker jailbroke Claude, with some ChatGPT help, to find and exploit flaws in Mexican government systems, stealing ~150GB incl. 195M taxpayer records. Target: Mexican tax authority, electoral institute, state governments. MX. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Sheinbaum denounces AI videos of her urging Mexicans to invest in Pemex shares
item.description: Sheinbaum said AI-generated Facebook reels showing her inviting people to invest in Pemex for 6,000 to 7,000 pesos a day were false and had circulated since November 2024; Condusef issued parallel alerts. Target: Mexican Facebook users; President Claudia Sheinbaum. MX. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Mexico's Condusef warns of AI voice-cloning calls used to request large bank transfers
item.description: Financial consumer regulator Condusef alerted the public that fraudsters were using AI to clone familiar voices in phone calls, typically to request large bank transfers, and linked it to a parallel WhatsApp scam. Target: Mexican bank customers. MX. Verification: confirmed.
